mapper.sql: tenant_id, id, `type`, payload, biz_key, `status`, attempts, last_error, next_retry_at_ms, lease_owner, lease_until_ms, created_at_ms, finished_at_ms
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cw_dead_letter (tenant_id, id, `type`, payload, biz_key, `status`, attempts, last_error, next_retry_at_ms, lease_owner, lease_until_ms, created_at_ms, finished_at_ms) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{id}, #{type}, #{payload}, #{bizKey}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{lastError}, #{nextRetryAtMs}, #{leaseOwner}, #{leaseUntilMs}, #{createdAtMs}, #{finishedAtMs}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE `status` = VALUES(`status`), attempts = VALUES(attempts), last_error = VALUES(last_error), next_retry_at_ms = VALUES(next_retry_at_ms), lease_owner = VALUES(lease_owner), lease_until_ms = VALUES(lease_until_ms), finished_at_ms = VALUES(finished_at_ms)
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM cw_dead_letter WHERE (`status` = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at_ms <= #{nowMs}) OR (`status` = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_until_ms <= #{nowMs}) ORDER BY next_retry_at_ms LIMIT #{limit}
